scope.note: CLI embedded-docs and README are reviewed by another worker. This review covers changed rows in the captured map only; rename-only files belong to the coordinator's mapping.

method: Read every captured unified-diff hunk for this exact scope, including every removed and added line. Assigned an explicit per-hunk classification and confirmation after reading. Parsed ranges and source/diff SHA-256 values are metadata; they are not substitutes for the manual review. One source-context search confirmed the cancellation sentinel producer/consumer. No active-checkout writes, application execution, builds, tests, installs, requests, commits, or branches.

classification_policy.identity-only: Documentation/comment or test-fixture naming change, or a renamed source reference whose represented runtime value is separately confirmed unchanged.
classification_policy.behavioral: An executable/public-API literal, environment name, path, predicate, target, or output changes. This includes runtime-visible identity changes even where control flow stays the same.
classification_policy.formatting: Whitespace/wrapping alone. Mixed formatting and identity behavior is classified behavioral and its line offset is recorded.

findings: The CLI Cargo target changes ice/src/bin/ice.rs to icers/src/bin/icers.rs. The coordinator must retain rename-only entrypoint mapping separately.

Extension event logging consumes ICERS_EVENT_LOG, ICERS_EVENT_LOG_PATH, and ICERS_CODING_AGENT_DIR, with .icers as the home default. Project package registry/artifacts and dev staging use .icers paths.

SDK HOST_NAME becomes icers and SESSION_ID_ENV becomes ICERS_SESSION_ID. The public constant identifier ICE_PLUGIN_ABI_VERSION_UNIFIED becomes ICERS_PLUGIN_ABI_VERSION_UNIFIED; its u32 value remains 4, so source consumers change while the represented ABI number does not.

TUI update-notice predicates recognize icers, PET_KEY becomes icers.pet, and displayed/logged/help/error strings use the new namespace. The key-trace documentation retains <temp>/ice-keys.log; no default-log-filename change appears in the captured diff.
The private cancellation sentinel text changes to NUL+icers:cancelled; a source-context read confirms producer and driver consume the same constant, keeping cancellation routed to cancelled_message.
